hero-title:
Private AI that knows your business.
Without your data ever leaving.
hero-description: RAGnexus turns your company's documents, systems, and internal knowledge into an accurate, private, and sector-specific AI assistant. Deployed in 4 weeks, with no technical team required, and, if you want, without sending a single piece of data to OpenAI or Google.
hero-trust-bar: GDPR Compliant · Data on European infrastructure · SOC 2-Ready · End-to-end encryption
problem-intro: Every company accumulates years of documents, conversations, and decisions. Most of it gets buried in folders, email threads, and disconnected tools. Meanwhile, your teams waste hours every week looking for what already exists.
problem-item-1: Information scattered across dozens tools that don't talk to each other.
problem-item-2: Employees rewriting what a coworker already did two years ago.
problem-item-3: Teams using ChatGPT in secret, exposing confidential data.
problem-item-4: Decisions delayed because "it's documented, but nobody can find it".
problem-outro: There is a better way. And it doesn't involve sending your data to a third party.
solution-title: Your own AI assistant. Grounded in your knowledge, not trained on it.
solution-subtitle: Three steps. Four weeks. Your data never leaves the EU.
solution-step-1-desc: We link RAGnexus with the tools where your information lives: SharePoint, Google Drive, Notion, Slack, Salesforce, your CRM, your ERP, your internal folders. Over 40 native integrations.
solution-step-2-desc: We build a private and secure knowledge base with your documents. Your data is processed in your infrastructure or on European servers under your control. It never goes to OpenAI, Google, or Microsoft.
solution-step-3-desc: Your team starts using the assistant from where they already work: browser, Slack, Teams, Outlook. Ask in natural language, get answers with the exact source cited, verifiable in one click.
verticals-subtitle: Every sector has different challenges. We designed RAGnexus to adapt to the language, workflows, and regulatory compliance of your industry. Select yours.
verticals-law-desc: Find precedents, clauses, and internal case law in seconds. Comply with attorney-client privilege. Without sending a single document to third parties.
verticals-health-desc: Instant access to protocols, records, and clinical guidelines. Designed to comply with GDPR and healthcare regulations.
verticals-consulting-desc: Capitalize on your firm's accumulated knowledge. Ensure every consultant has the entire company's experience at their fingertips.
verticals-not-listed: Your sector is not listed? Let's talk.
compare-title: Why not just use ChatGPT, Copilot, or Gemini?
compare-subtitle: Because they do something different. ChatGPT gives you general answers. RAGnexus gives you answers about your company.
compare-f2b: Deployment option with no external API calls
compare-f2c: Your data is not used to train models
compare-f3: Cites the exact source for every answer
compare-closure: We don't compete with the major AI providers. We combine their models — or European open-source alternatives — with an architecture that keeps your data under your control, on European infrastructure, and GDPR-compliant. You choose the level of sovereignty: from European cloud deployments to 100% on-premises solutions on your own servers.
integrations-section-title: Connects with the tools you already use.
integrations-section-subtitle: RAGnexus natively integrates with over 40 productivity, storage, CRM, and communication platforms. If your company uses it, we probably connect to it.
about-ragnexus-description: RAGnexus is a company specialized in creating customized personal assistants using RAG (Retriever-Augmented Generation) technology. Our assistants are designed to provide highly personalized and contextually relevant responses to our clients' individual needs. We use private information provided by customers to ensure that responses are accurate and tailored to each specific use case.

offer-carousel.title: Retriever-Augmented Generation (RAG) tech uses a 2 step approach for generating responses:
offer-carousel.description:
**First**, it retrieves relevant information from a database.

**Second**, it uses that information to generate accurate and context-specific answers.

offer-carousel.title: Personalization and Relevance:
offer-carousel.description:
We get your provided knowledge base and use it to generate a responses that are relevant to your use case.

Data is kept private and secure following the highest security standards.

offer-carousel.title: Get the ultimate competitive advantage with RAG:
offer-carousel.description: Get ahead of the competition by providing your employees with a tool that can generate accurate and context-specific answers.

final-cta-subtitle: No canned presentations. No obligation to buy. In 20 minutes, we'll tell you honestly if RAGnexus makes sense for your company — or if it doesn't.
